SELECT VERSION_ID AS V, PERIOD AS K,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'revenue', AMOUNT, 0)) AS REV, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'cogs', AMOUNT, 0)) AS COGS,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'opex', AMOUNT, 0)) AS OPEX, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'da', AMOUNT, 0)) AS DA,
  COUNT_IF(AMOUNT IS NULL) AS MASKED
FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.CANVAS.SV_PLAN WHERE FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 AND VERSION_ID IN (1,2,3) AND MODULE IN ('revenue','cogs','opex','da') GROUP BY 1, 2;
SELECT VERSION_ID AS V, PERIOD AS K, SUM(SHIPMENTS) AS SHIP FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.CANVAS.SV_OPS WHERE FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 AND VERSION_ID IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1, 2;
